payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the G-SAT model consistently outperforms existing systems (GLAD and GCE) in terms of accuracy across multiple experiments and languages.

claims.text: G-SAT outperforms GLAD and GCE in accuracy on both development and test datasets across three languages.
G-SAT achieves higher joint goal performance compared to GLAD and GCE, indicating superior accuracy.
The performance of G-SAT is consistent across different embedding sizes, further supporting its accuracy advantage.
